input_status: Commercial inputs are scenario assumptions, not supplier quotes or measured site costs. Simulation-derived inputs are loaded separately from final validation.
notes: A section is one 6 x 4 m modeled bay, not one raster lane. The 504 m2/day workload is assumed and is not inferred from an electrical 100 kWp model.
Manual labour price cancels under normalization; no real currency amount or verified commercial saving is claimed.
Repeated independent attempts after failure, human recovery and between-bay transfer are business assumptions; the simulator does not demonstrate autonomous between-bay movement.
M/M/1 assumes Poisson arrivals and exponential service. Measured service capacity calibrates the mean, not these distribution assumptions.
No electrical PV-yield or power-restoration percentage is inferred from dust mass or coverage. Discounting, financing, tax and coating damage are outside this simple-payback scenario.
